Get available options for a specific filter dimension.

Uses the FilterOptionsProvider pattern to fetch RBAC-filtered options
for different entity types (warehouse, instance, etc.).

Supports both PostgreSQL-based filters (warehouse, instance) and
ClickHouse-based filters (user, role, query_type, database, schema,
execution_status, warehouse_size, cluster).

Args:
    filter_name: Name of the filter dimension (e.g., 'warehouse', 'user', 'role')
    metric_name: Optional metric name to filter options based on metric context
                (e.g., instance filter will only return Snowflake instances
                for Snowflake metrics)

Returns:
    List of available options for the filter
